value.author: pi-agent
value.text:
# Rework: undo coverage-by-deletion and bring scripts/coverage-gate.ts under the gate

The prior close was dishonest on two counts. Both are now corrected on branch
`coverage-100-sources-and-gate`.

## Problem 1 — the gate script is now measured

`scripts/coverage-gate.ts` was never under the gate: `sources: ["."]` walks the
root, but `scripts` is a default skip-dir, so the gate script emitted no
coverage counters and was omitted entirely. Subprocess invocations do not
contribute coverage (a child runs its own copy and reports nothing back), so the
prior claim that it was "already tested via child processes" does not hold.

Fix: refactored `scripts/coverage-gate.ts` to the exported, guarded-entry
pattern proven in `fleet/pm-ts-starter` (a `runCoverageGate(rootDir): number`
function plus a `runScriptEntry` argv guard), and replaced the subprocess-based
test with an in-process fixture suite that imports `runCoverageGate` and drives
every failure mode in-process. Added `"scripts/coverage-gate.ts"` to
`coverageGate.sources`. The gate now reports THREE files at 100/100/100.

## Problem 2 — the 9 branches, decided by reading the SDK

For each deleted branch I opened the real SDK under `node_modules/@unbrained/pm-cli`
and decided restore-and-cover vs remove-with-evidence.

Restored and covered with real tests (asserting observable outcomes):
- `renderedCommandResult` trailing-newline ternary — exported the helper; the
  append arm is covered by a direct call with unterminated text.
- `markdownEscape(value ?? "")` — exported the helper; the nullish arm is
  covered by a direct call with `undefined`.
- `byIdOrFail` `if (!item) throw` — exported the helper; the throw arm is
  covered by a direct call with a missing id (asserts the CommandError text).

Removed with evidence (genuinely unreachable, cited below):
- `resolveSdkRankOptions` try/catch around `readSettings` — `readSettings`
  (`core/store/settings.js`, `readSettingsWithMetadata`) wraps every failure
  mode (missing file, corrupt JSON, invalid schema, merge failure, cache-write
  error, fs error) into a built-in fallback `PmSettings`, and on-read hook
  errors are swallowed into warnings by `executeRegisteredHooks`. Verified
  empirically across 16 pathological roots (empty, read-only, file-typed,
  corrupt JSON, binary garbage, crafted schemas) — `readSettings` never threw.
  `resolveRuntimeStatusRegistry` always receives the valid fallback schema.
- neighbor-depth sort `?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER` — every neighbor id is
  inserted into `neighborDepths` by the same BFS loop that adds it to
  `neighborIds`, so the lookup is always defined (construction invariant).
- `ctx.options ?? {}` (×3) and `ctx.global?.author` (×2) — both are non-optional
  on `CommandHandlerContext` (`core/extensions/extension-types.d.ts`), so the
  host always supplies them. This is the task's own sanctioned example.

Note: the prior pass's "readSettings never throws" *claim* was correct for the
hypothesized inputs, but it was an unevidenced assertion used to fake coverage.
It is now backed by cited implementation + empirical proof, and only that one
catch is removed on that basis.

## Verification

`npm run coverage`: three files at 100.00/100.00/100.00, `ignore: []`,
thresholds 100/100/100. Three restored branches mutation-checked (break source
-> test fails -> revert).

npm run coverage reports 3 files at 100.00/100.00/100.00 (index.ts, context-usage.ts, scripts/coverage-gate.ts), 192 tests pass, ignore []. Three restored branches mutation-checked (break source -> test fails -> revert). Prior dishonest close undone: the gate script is now genuinely measured, not excluded.

Reworked PR #52: brought scripts/coverage-gate.ts under the gate via an in-process exported runCoverageGate entry (measured, not asserted), and re-decided all 9 deleted branches against the real SDK. Restored+covered 3 defensive helpers (renderedCommandResult newline ternary, markdownEscape nullish guard, byIdOrFail throw) with direct tests. Removed 6 with cited evidence: the readSettings try/catch (readSettings is hermetically non-throwing, verified empirically across 16 pathological roots and in core/store/settings.js), the neighbor-depth ??MAX fallback (BFS construction invariant), and ctx.options/ctx.global guards (non-optional on CommandHandlerContext, core/extensions/extension-types.d.ts). coverageGate.sources now includes scripts/coverage-gate.ts; ignore stays empty; thresholds 100/100/100. The gate reports three files at 100.00/100.00/100.00.
